scope: Multi trip type: Leg form (Local/Outstation/Transfer chips per leg), Add Next Stop, edit/delete legs, per-leg dates/times, validation, location picker, Trip Summary, vehicles/filters/pricing, Vehicle Details & breakup, Confirm, Inquiry, Inquiry Details, payment attempt, Cancel Trip; baseline TC_HOME_038-041 + gap cases
executedBy: Claude Code (App Live via Claude in Chrome)

credentials.method: Entered manually on device by the user; values from .env - not seen or logged by Claude

approvals.text: User request (chat, 2026-10-01): test Multi completely incl. Confirm -> Inquiry -> Inquiry Details, applicable payment/cancellation (payment not integrated - record Blocked/Fail). Claude will not enter card/UPI/bank details. New genuine Multi cases pre-approved for CSV/XLSX.

environmentNotes: Test data created and cleaned up: Multi inquiries 527-529 (3 legs: Local/Outstation/Transfer) and the 2-leg pair ending 530 (Local multi-day + Transfer) - cancelled via one leg each (INV-62, INV-63), which cancelled all linked legs. Pay Advance attempted on 529 (gateway error); no payment details entered.

cases.actual: Multi tab: "Leg 1 Local" with Local (selected) / Outstation / Transfer chips; Local leg fields (Pickup Location, Pickup Date & Time, Number of Passengers, Number of Hours, Additional Options Multi-day trip / Different drop location); Add Next Stop button; Search Vehicles.
Add Next Stop with Leg 1 empty -> inline "Pickup location is required" under Pickup Location; no Leg 2 added (form scrolled back to Leg 1).

After Leg 1 (Local, Majestic, 04-10 11:30 am, 4 h) Add Next Stop collapses Leg 1 into a chip 'Leg 1 : Majestic ... -> Same as pickup' with X and opens 'Leg 2 Local'; choosing Outstation switches Leg 2 to Outstation fields (Pickup, Pickup Date & Time, First Destination, + Add Another Destination, Drop Date & Time, Passengers, Different drop location). Leg 2 filled Majestic -> Mysuru 06-10 12:14 pm to 07-10 12:00 pm. Leg chips have an X (remove).
cases.notes: Switching the leg type discards the values prefilled for the leg (pickup and date reset to empty/today).

cases.scenario: New leg defaults continue from the previous leg (pickup = previous drop/destination, start after previous end)
cases.preconditions: Multi with Leg 1 Local (Majestic, 04-10 11:30, 4 h) and Leg 2 Outstation (Majestic -> Mysuru, 06-10 to 07-10)
cases.steps: 1. Add Next Stop after Leg 1 2. Note Leg 2 defaults 3. Add Next Stop after Leg 2 4. Note Leg 3 defaults
cases.expected: Next leg pickup = previous leg drop/destination; date/time defaults after the previous leg ends
cases.actual: Leg 2 defaulted to Leg 1's pickup and exact start (Majestic, 04-10 11:30 am - overlapping Leg 1's 4 h). Leg 3 defaulted to Leg 2's pickup Majestic and start 06-10 12:14 pm instead of Mysuru / after 07-10 12:00.

cases.scenario: Filled leg still open in the form is included on Search Vehicles
cases.preconditions: Legs 1-2 committed (chips); Leg 3 Transfer fully filled but not committed with Add Next Stop
cases.steps: 1. Fill Leg 3 completely 2. Tap Search Vehicles (without Add Next Stop)
cases.expected: All filled legs (1-3) included, or user warned that the open leg is not saved
cases.actual: Trip Summary shows only Leg 1 and Leg 2 tabs - the filled open Leg 3 is silently dropped. With a single fully filled open leg and no committed legs, Search shows "Please add at least one journey to continue." Only after Add Next Stop (which commits the leg and opens a copy) is it included; the new open leg is then ignored.

cases.scenario: Leg dated before the previous legs (chronology)
cases.steps: 1. Leg 3 Transfer pickup/drop 02-10 2. Commit leg 3 3. Search Vehicles
cases.expected: Validation: each leg must start after the previous leg ends
cases.actual: Accepted - summary shows Leg 3 'Transfer (Point to Point)' Mysuru -> Majestic dated 02 Oct 2026, before Leg 1 (04 Oct). No chronology or overlap validation (Leg 2 default also overlapped Leg 1).

Summary 'Now you're ready to explore' with Leg 1 / Leg 2 / Leg 3 tabs: Leg 1 'Local Trip' Majestic -> Same as Pickup, 80 KM, 04 Oct; Leg 2 'Outstation Trip' Majestic -> Mysuru 600 KM 06-07 Oct; Leg 3 'Transfer (Point to Point)' Mysuru -> Majestic < 30 KM 02 Oct; Review Inquiry & Select Vehicles (Vehicle Age, Comfort Priority). Summary lists legs correctly, but pricing does not combine legs: list Rs 11,000, Confirm Rs 12,000 (Leg 1 only), inquiries Rs 36,000 each x3.

cases.scenario: Multi-leg vehicle list price reflects all legs
cases.preconditions: 3-leg Multi search (Local 4 h + Outstation 2 days + Transfer)
cases.steps: 1. Search Vehicles 2. Read Starts From; 3. Premium chip
cases.expected: Starts From = combined estimate of all legs
cases.actual: '20 vehicles found'; 33 Seater Deluxe Coach Rs 11,000 (about the Local 4 h leg alone; Outstation day rate is Rs 16,500). Premium chip -> 7 vehicles (filtering works).

cases.scenario: Multi-leg Confirm lists every leg with a combined estimate
cases.steps: 1. Book Now 2. Review route summary, dates, Estimated Trip Cost
cases.expected: All legs (routes, dates) shown; total = sum of legs
cases.actual: Run 1 (3 legs): badge 'Multi-Leg (Local)', only Leg 1 route/date (4 Oct), Rs 10,000 + bata 1,000 + 1,000 = Rs 12,000. Run 2 (Local multi-day 8-9 Oct + Transfer 10-11 Oct, Sedan): only Leg 1 shown (dates 8,9 Oct), base Rs 4,000 (single day for a 2-day leg) + bata 500 + 500 = Rs 5,000; list said Rs 9,500. Legs 2+ never shown or priced.

cases.expected: Success modal with combined estimate; one linked booking
cases.actual: 'Inquiry Submitted Successfully!' Estimated Cost Rs 12,000 - but three separate inquiries were created (Inquired 11 -> 14), each Rs 36,000.

cases.scenario: Multi-leg inquiry appears with correct per-leg data and amounts
cases.expected: Legs linked/grouped; distances and amounts match the summary/Confirm
cases.actual: Run 1: 3 cards (Local 80 KM/Day, OutStation 0 km, Transfer < 30 KM/Day) each Rs 36,000 vs Rs 12,000 confirmed. Run 2: 2 cards (Local 2 days, Transfer 2 days, Sedan) each Rs 10,000 vs Rs 5,000 confirmed; future-dated legs appear only under Month (expected filter behaviour). No grouping as one Multi trip.

cases.scenario: Multi-leg inquiry details per leg (distance, schedule, amount)
cases.steps: 1. View Details on the OutStation leg card
cases.expected: 600 km, 6-7 Oct, pickup 12:14 pm, return 07-10 12:00 pm, leg amount
cases.actual: Inquiry 529 (Outstation leg): Distance 0 km, Expected arrival 03:30 pm (Leg 1 end). Inquiry 530 (Transfer leg, 10-11 Oct): Expected arrival 01:47 pm = pickup + Leg 1's 1 hour, not the leg's own drop (11-10 12:47 pm). Total Rs10000 vs Rs 5,000 confirmed.
Multi-leg inquiry 529: Pay Advance (500, Razorpay) -> 'Payment Error - "gateway" is not allowed field' (payment not integrated).
Gateway never opens (same 'gateway' error), so payment cancel/failure cannot be tested.

cases.scenario: Cancelling one leg of a multi-leg inquiry
cases.preconditions: 3 leg inquiries from one Multi Confirm
cases.steps: 1. Open Outstation leg 529 2. Cancel Trip 3. Confirm Cancellation 4. Check Inquired
cases.expected: Dialog states scope (this leg / whole trip); amounts based on the leg; only intended legs cancelled
cases.actual: Dialog for Inquiry 529 only: trip cost Rs12,000 (inquiry shows Rs36,000), slab 3 days <= T < 7 days 10%, penalty Rs1,200, refund Rs10,800 on an unpaid inquiry; invoice INV-62. After closing, Inquired 14 -> 11: all three legs were cancelled without warning.

cases.scenario: Multi leg of type Transfer By Hour with per-leg validation
cases.steps: 1. Leg 1 Transfer > By Hour 2. Pickup Majestic, 05-10 12:34 pm 3. Hours 0 4. Add Next Stop 5. Hours 3 6. Add Next Stop
cases.expected: Leg shows By Hour fields; 0 hours blocked with an error; valid leg commits
cases.actual: Leg 1 Transfer shows Point To Point / By Hour segment; By Hour shows Pickup, Date & Time, Passengers, Hours, Additional Options. Hours 0 -> 'Enter at least 1 hour', leg not committed; Hours 3 -> leg committed as chip 'Leg 1 : Majestic ... -> Same as pickup'.

cases.scenario: Committed legs persist when switching bottom-nav tabs
cases.preconditions: Multi with Leg 1 committed and Leg 2 open
cases.expected: Multi tab with leg chips and open leg intact
cases.actual: After Ride -> Home the Multi tab still shows the Leg 1 chip and the open Leg 2 (Transfer By Hour, Majestic, 05-10 12:34 pm).

cases.scenario: Remove committed legs via chip X (first and middle) and renumbering
cases.steps: 1. Tap X on Leg 1 chip (with Leg 2 open) 2. With 5 legs, tap X on Leg 3
cases.expected: Leg removed (ideally with confirmation); remaining legs renumbered in order
cases.actual: X on Leg 1 removed it immediately and the open leg became 'Leg 1'. With 5 legs, X on Leg 3 left Legs 1-4 and open 'Leg 5' - renumbering correct.
cases.notes: No confirmation before deleting a leg; tapping a chip does not open it for editing (committed legs can only be deleted; no edit or reorder).

cases.scenario: Maximum number of legs and duplicate/overlapping legs
cases.steps: 1. Commit identical legs repeatedly with Add Next Stop
cases.expected: A maximum is enforced and duplicate/overlapping legs are flagged
cases.actual: 5 identical legs (same pickup, same date/time) committed plus open Leg 6 - no maximum, no duplicate or overlap warning.

cases.scenario: App stability while editing a multi-leg form
cases.preconditions: Multi: Leg 1 Local multi-day (8, 9 Oct) committed; Leg 2 Transfer P2P being edited
cases.steps: 1. Set Leg 2 pickup date 10-10 2. Scroll the form
cases.expected: App stays open; form state retained
cases.actual: While scrolling, the app closed to the Android home screen. Relaunching started fresh on Home (Local tab) - all Multi legs lost. Observed once; logcat not captured, so the crash cause is unconfirmed.

cases.scenario: Switching trip type away from Multi with committed legs
cases.expected: Legs kept, or a warning before the itinerary is discarded
cases.actual: Returning to Multi shows a fresh 'Leg 1 Local' - the committed legs were discarded silently.
Multi context: Clear with 4 committed legs removes all legs and resets to the Local tab (no confirmation).
cases.notes: Re-executed in Multi context; wiping a whole itinerary without confirmation is a UX risk (see BUG-MLT-008).

cases.scenario: Per-leg validation: leg drop before leg pickup
cases.preconditions: Multi Leg 2 Transfer P2P, pickup 10-10, drop 01-10
cases.expected: Leg not committed; clear error on the drop date
cases.actual: Leg not committed; 'Please select a later time.' under the drop time (same unclear wording as BUG-TRF-001).

cases.scenario: Multi-day dates inside a Multi leg
cases.steps: 1. Toggle Multi-day trip in Leg 1 2. Select 8 and 9 Oct 3. Commit 4. Search
cases.expected: Calendar selection kept; summary shows both dates
cases.actual: Calendar shows; 'Selected Dates (2): Oct 8, 2026, Oct 9, 2026'; Trip Summary Leg 1 'Local Trip' Dates '8, 9 Oct 2026'; Leg 2 Transfer '10-11 Oct, 2026'.
cases.notes: Next leg copied Multi-day ON from the previous leg.

cases.scenario: Category chips and Filters on Multi results
cases.steps: 1. Premium chip 2. Clear 3. Filters > Sedan > Apply
cases.actual: Premium -> 7 vehicles; Filters Vehicle Type Sedan -> '1 vehicles found' Sedan Rs 9,500.

cases.scenario: Cancellation 7+ days before trip start (fully refundable slab)
cases.preconditions: Multi Transfer-leg inquiry 530 starting 10-10 (8 days 23 h away), no advance paid
cases.steps: 1. Cancel Trip 2. Review slab 3. Confirm Cancellation
cases.actual: Trip cost Rs5,000, penalty 0%, add one day charge No, penalty retained Rs0, refund Rs5,000, slab 'T >= 7 days - fully refundable'; Booking Cancelled 530, invoice INV-63. Both Multi legs removed (Month Inquired 12 -> 10, BUG-MLT-006 2/2).
cases.notes: Refund on an unpaid inquiry still tracked under BUG-OUT-014.

cases.actual: Multi leg Pickup Location: 'zzqxv' -> blank list after 7 s, no 'No results' message (same as BUG-LOC-001 in run android-20260930-1058-LOCAL).
cases.notes: Re-executed in Multi context; existing defect, not re-filed.

bugs.title: Multi: new leg copies the previous leg's start instead of continuing from its drop/end
steps: Home > Multi; Leg 1 Local Majestic 04-10 11:30 am, 4 h
Add Next Stop - observe Leg 2 defaults
Fill Leg 2 Outstation Majestic -> Mysuru 06-10 to 07-10; Add Next Stop - observe Leg 3 defaults
bugs.expected: Next leg pickup = previous drop/destination; start after previous end
bugs.actual: Leg 2 = Majestic 04-10 11:30 (overlaps Leg 1); Leg 3 = Majestic 06-10 12:14 (not Mysuru, overlaps Leg 2)

bugs.title: Multi: the leg open in the form is silently dropped on Search Vehicles
steps: Home > Multi; commit Legs 1-2 with Add Next Stop
Fill Leg 3 completely
Tap Search Vehicles
bugs.expected: Leg 3 included (or a prompt to save/discard it)
bugs.actual: Summary shows only committed legs; the filled open leg is lost without notice. With only an open (uncommitted) leg, Search shows "Please add at least one journey to continue." although a complete leg is on screen. Committing via Add Next Stop creates a pre-filled extra leg which is in turn ignored

bugs.title: Multi: no chronology/overlap validation between legs
steps: Leg 1 04-10, Leg 2 06-07 Oct
Leg 3 pickup/drop 02-10
Search Vehicles
bugs.expected: Error: leg must start after previous leg ends
bugs.actual: Accepted; Leg 3 shown as 02 Oct before Leg 1

bugs.title: Multi-leg pricing broken: list Rs 11,000, Confirm Rs 12,000 (Leg 1 only), then 3 inquiries at Rs 36,000 each
steps: Multi: Leg 1 Local 4 h, Leg 2 Outstation 2 days, Leg 3 Transfer
Search > 33 Seater Deluxe Coach (Rs 11,000) > Book Now
Confirm shows 'Multi-Leg (Local)', Leg 1 only, Rs 12,000; Confirm
My Bookings > Week > Inquired
bugs.expected: One combined estimate across all legs, consistent on every screen; inquiries match the confirmed amount
bugs.actual: Rs 11,000 -> Rs 12,000 -> three inquiries each Rs 36,000 (Rs 1,08,000) after approving Rs 12,000

bugs.title: Multi Outstation leg saved with 0 km and the wrong expected-arrival time
steps: Submit a Multi inquiry with an Outstation leg (Majestic -> Mysuru, 06-10 12:14 to 07-10 12:00; summary 600 KM)
Open the OutStation card / Inquiry 529
bugs.actual: Distance 0 km; 'Expected arrival 03:30 pm' (Leg 1 end time)
bugs.reproducibility: Always (2/2: Inquiry 529 Outstation leg, Inquiry 530 Transfer leg)

bugs.title: Cancelling one Multi leg silently cancels all legs; dialog amount (Rs12,000) differs from the inquiry total (Rs36,000)
steps: Submit a 3-leg Multi inquiry
Open one leg (529) > Cancel Trip > Confirm Cancellation
Check Inquired count
bugs.expected: Scope stated; only intended leg(s) cancelled; amounts consistent
bugs.actual: Only 529 mentioned; all three legs removed (14 -> 11); one invoice INV-62 on trip cost Rs12,000

bugs.title: App closed unexpectedly while scrolling the Multi form; all legs lost on relaunch

Leg 2 Transfer P2P Majestic -> KIA; set pickup date 10-10
Scroll the form down
bugs.expected: App remains open with form state
bugs.actual: App closed to the Android home screen; relaunch opened Home (Local) with the Multi itinerary lost
bugs.errorInfo: Not captured - App Live logcat was closed; cause (crash vs. process kill) unconfirmed. Check device logs/Crashlytics for com.siddaganga around 2026-10-01 12:46 device time

bugs.title: Switching trip type or tapping Clear silently discards an entire Multi itinerary

Tap the Local tab (or Clear)
Return to Multi
bugs.expected: Legs kept per tab, or a confirmation before discarding
bugs.actual: Fresh 'Leg 1 Local'; all legs lost without warning
